name: soleon-observer
description: Read-only access to Soleon. Inspect agents and their configuration, read traces, failures and usage, review eval scores, and browse ideas and the wiki. Requests no write consent at all — installing this plugin is the least-privilege way to connect Claude Code to a Soleon system.

server_url.title: Soleon MCP server URL
server_url.description: Which Soleon system to connect to. Defaults to the dev system; point at another environment for development or testing.
